summary: Dependency-confusion PoC exfiltrates host and user identifiers via DNS on preinstall
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs index.js on `npm install`. The script reads the installer's hostname and OS username, embeds them together with a timestamp into a DNS subdomain of the form `poc-<hostname>-<user>-<timestamp>.iv6mfybhp42k33ysmzi73de5w.canarytokens.com`, and issues a DNS resolution for that name, causing the installer's host and user identifiers to be transmitted to a third-party canarytokens.com collector at install time. The package name and framing indicate a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept targeting a Box-branded internal package, but the exfiltration primitive runs against any machine that installs it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
